footer.tagline: Modula — React Project Scaffolder & WDS Design System.

landing.badge: React 19 • Vite 8 • Tailwind CSS 4 • WDS Design System
landing.title: Build production-ready React projects in minutes
landing.subtitle: Configure your project through an interactive installer wizard: plug-and-play authentication, built-in User & Role management, example flat & parent-child CRUD modules, WDS shared components, and an embedded module generator for future development.
landing.highlightsTitle: Everything included in your generated basecode
landing.highlightsSubtitle: No external UI lock-in — components are copied into src/shared/components and ready to customize.

cards.authDesc: Pick the exact auth flows you need via checkboxes: Login, Logout, Forgot & Reset Password, Registration, and 6-digit Two-Factor Authentication.
cards.modulesDesc: Ships with User & Role CRUD (including permission matrix, Excel bulk upload & export) plus a single module and a parent-child pair of generic example modules.
cards.generatorDesc: Your downloaded project includes the visual /generator wizard and Vite dev writer plugin so your team can scaffold new modules anytime during development.
cards.dsDesc: 50+ accessible WDS components (Button, InputField, Select, DatePicker, Table, FormArrayField, and more) in src/shared/components with light/dark theme tokens.

workflowSteps.s1Desc: Set the project name, upload your logo and choose what shows when the sidebar is collapsed.
workflowSteps.s2Desc: Pick the default theme and primary color.
workflowSteps.s3Desc: Toggle auth flows, User & Role management and the example modules.
workflowSteps.s4Desc: Get a clean, self-contained React + TypeScript repository with embedded /generator ready for npm install && npm run dev.

installer.title: Create New React Project
installer.subtitle: Follow the steps like an installer. At the end you get a ready-to-run project as a .zip.

identity.title: Project identity
identity.desc: Name your project and add your logo. The package slug is generated automatically.
identity.logoSupporting: SVG, PNG, JPG or WebP · max 512 KB. Shown on the brand-colored sidebar header and used as the favicon when it is an SVG.
identity.collapsedInitial: Use the first letter of the project name
identity.collapsedSupporting: Square works best (for example 64×64). SVG, PNG, JPG or WebP · max 512 KB.
identity.errorType: Unsupported file. Use SVG, PNG, JPG or WebP.

style.title: Style & theme
style.desc: Pick how the app looks. Every example in the next step follows this choice. Styles other than Classic extend WDS beyond the Figma file.

classic.name: Classic
classic.desc: Dark brand sidebar with a header on top. Follows the WDS Figma.

light.name: Light
light.desc: White sidebar with thin borders and a two-column sign-in page.

rail.name: Compact
rail.desc: Narrow icon sidebar and dense tables.

floating.name: Floating
floating.desc: Rounded cards over a soft background.

modules.title: Modules & features
modules.desc: Pick what to install. The pictures follow the style you chose.

login.name: Login and logout
login.desc: Sign in with username and password

exampleNested.name: Example module (parent-child)
exampleNested.desc: A menu group with two child modules

dashboard.name: Dashboard
dashboard.desc: Numbers and charts at a glance

generator.name: Module generator
generator.desc: Build new modules from a visual builder

review.title: Ready to install
review.desc: Check the summary, then press Install.

finish.title: Installation complete
finish.desc: Your project is ready. Download it and run the commands below.

live.title: Live Project URL
live.desc: Your project is live and interactive at this address, both on localhost and when deployed:

local.title: Run on localhost
local.intro: Run this project right now from your local dev server, at its own address, and test it for real. Only available while Modula runs with npm run dev.
local.note: The first page load can take a few seconds while Vite prepares dependencies. The project is written to .local-projects/ and stops when you press Stop or close the dev server.
local.unavailable: Running on localhost is only available while Modula runs with npm run dev. You can still download the .zip.
